title: Red panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M75 70 Q90 60 88 45 Q86 35 78 38 Q72 40 74 50 Q76 58 70 65 Z" fill="#C0392B" stroke="#E67E22" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M84 42 Q82 38 78 39" fill="none" stroke="#F5CBA7" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M79 44 Q77 41 74 42" fill="none" stroke="#F5CBA7" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M75 50 Q73 47 70 49" fill="none" stroke="#F5CBA7" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- left leg -->
  <rect x="30" y="72" width="10" height="16" rx="4" fill="#8B2500"/>
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="89" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#5C1A00"/>

  <!-- right leg (dancing, lifted) -->
  <rect x="55" y="66" width="10" height="15" rx="4" fill="#8B2500" transform="rotate(-20 60 73)"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="82" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#5C1A00" transform="rotate(-20 63 82)"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="60" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#D35400"/>

  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="64" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#A04000"/>

  <!-- left arm (raised up dancing) -->
  <path d="M30 52 Q18 40 15 28" stroke="#D35400" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="26" r="5" fill="#5C1A00"/>

  <!-- right arm (out to the side) -->
  <path d="M65 52 Q78 48 82 55" stroke="#D35400" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="56" r="5" fill="#5C1A00"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="32" rx="19" ry="17" fill="#D35400"/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="19" rx="7" ry="8" fill="#A04000"/>
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="19" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#F5CBA7"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="19" rx="7" ry="8" fill="#A04000"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="19" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#F5CBA7"/>

  <!-- face markings -->
  <path d="M47 30 Q40 38 36 34 Q32 30 38 28 Z" fill="#FDF5E6"/>
  <path d="M47 30 Q54 38 58 34 Q62 30 56 28 Z" fill="#FDF5E6"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="40.5" cy="28.5" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="#1A1A2E"/>
  <circle cx="56.5" cy="28.5" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="36" rx="3" ry="2.2" fill="#2C1A0E"/>

  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d="M43 39 Q47 43 51 39" stroke="#2C1A0E" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="35" r="3" fill="#E74C3C" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="35" r="3" fill="#E74C3C" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill="#F1C40F">
    <ellipse cx="80" cy="30" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" transform="rotate(-20 80 30)"/>
    <rect x="82" y="18" width="1.8" height="12"/>
    <path d="M82 18 Q88 16 88 22" stroke="#F1C40F" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>

    <ellipse cx="14" cy="62" rx="3" ry="2.2" transform="rotate(-20 14 62)"/>
    <rect x="15.5" y="52" width="1.5" height="10"/>
    <path d="M15.5 52 Q21 50 21 55" stroke="#F1C40F" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none"/>
  </g>
</svg>
